—Ah, yes.
Thank you very much for such a wonderful invitation.
I wondered if she would accept the idea—

The sound of waves ebbing and flowing. The scent of the ocean breeze caressing our cheeks.
The air carrying the quiet excitement unique to a summer night. And then—
I sat down on the sofa and pulled out my smartphone.

Words exchanged little by little.
A natural, gentle interaction.

At summer camp, sleeping arrangements change, and so do meals and daily rhythms.
Amid all that, I was concerned about whether she was able to truly relax.
Would you please teach me how to make it?

I grow some in my room on a regular basis.
Today, I came here in search of new decorative pieces.

On top of the unfamiliar environment, dealing with different staff than usual,
and designing training regimens unique to the camp—

Yes. There is still plenty of time left in the camp,
so I hope to find something.

The drain from all of this would surely catch up with me sooner or later,
leading to exhaustion... I could already predict it.

The pleasure is all mine. Thanks to you, I was able to enjoy
the most fulfilling rest since the start of summer camp.
This is—
A suggestion, you say?

Ah—
Regarding that, well...

Holding back my excitement,
I began explaining the craft I had learned from the video.

My mother does everything with such meticulous care,
and every time I see that, my respect for her only deepens—

Yes.
I enjoy working with my hands, such as creating mossariums.
Like taking the leap to put black soybeans into cookies, for instance.

Today wrapped up successfully as well, leaving only the cooldown.
If there was anything on my mind, it was—

Nodding, I showed her what I had bought.
Plastic containers with lids, a craft knife, adhesive, and so on.

*Gulp*, *gulp*, *gulp*—...
Phew~...!

There, the hole for the sand to pass through is done.
Next, we attach these two together with adhesive... like so.

My voice had somehow turned into a murmur. I wasn't used to making suggestions myself,
nor did I think I had any real artistic flair.

—Words that made me happier than anything. Just hearing them
made me genuinely glad that I had made the suggestion.
Baking sweets together, knitting, growing plants.

Summer camp had begun. Right from the start,
Air Messiah was in great shape, and training was progressing smoothly.
...To be honest, I haven't really found anything fulfilling yet.

An experience unique to this place, isn't it?
I am quite interested.

In this environment, about the only thing available to me are e-books.
So in terms of engaging in active rest, not quite so much.

It is taking shape nicely.
Next, for the sand... let us take some from here.

Ah, but—there have been times where
I felt like trying out a little challenge of my own.

The gentle sound of trickling sand is so soothing...
This has become a wonderful keepsake.

Hoping to kill some time, I opened a video app and started scrolling.
Just then—one particular video caught my eye.
...I often spent moments like this with my mother as well.

Wanting to be like her...
I began to face every single thing earnestly and steadfastly.

I began to learn more personal sides of her that I never would
have discovered through our usual everyday conversations.

Every time I saw them, a warm feeling welled up inside me—
and my desire to support Air Messiah grew even stronger.

Sitting side by side in my room are the cactus we bought on a trip
and the hourglass we made together at the beach.

Oh, my...
Do you mean using the sand from right here?

...When it comes to taking the plunge,
she really hasn't changed all that much from the past.

I sent Air Messiah a message,
then hurried out to buy the necessary supplies.
And so, life returned to its usual routine.
As I told her that—

Beneath the summer sky—
the two of us worked side by side for quite some time.
It is a moss terrarium—often called a mossarium.

Thinking back to how she used to be, I looked down at my phone once more.
—I might have just come up with a great idea.
—It's finished.
The soothing, gentle sound of flowing sand resonated—
After that, summer training camp came to a safe and successful close—

Thank you for waiting.
So, Trainer, what seems to be the matter?
—It turned out that I hadn't found a way to truly relax either.
(Whoosh... Whoosh...)
